verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents built-in conversation analysis: custom success-evaluation criteria for goal achievement, sentiment analysis across completed conversations, structured data collection and conversation search. Marketing also says agents can be 'monitored'. However, the evidence never shows an aggregate analytics dashboard with success rates or call durations; the max-duration setting is a configuration limit, not a metric. Missing for 10: documented analytics dashboard with aggregated success rates, call-duration metrics, outcome charts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own

citations.quote: Success evaluation: Define custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement, and customer satisfaction
Sentiment analysis: Understand user sentiment across completed conversations
Configure, deploy and monitor natural, human-sounding agents in 70+ languages
